tasks.title: Phase2: injection hardening (secure-field gate + full clipboard backup + truthful logs)
tasks.outcome: Injection refuses confirmed password fields (ES_PASSWORD + UIA IsPassword probe, fail-open with log); clipboard backup enumerates all formats and restores them; usage logs are written after inject() with real strategy/latency/success; frecency counts success-only.

acceptance.criterion: probe_secure_field uses GetGUIThreadInfo/ES_PASSWORD and UIA IsPassword read-only; confirmed secure -> inject aborts with logged refusal; probe failure -> proceed + log gate_unchecked
acceptance.verify_by: review service/src/injector/ gate code + Cargo feature Win32_UI_Accessibility already present

acceptance.criterion: Clipboard backup enumerates EnumClipboardFormats, copies HGLOBAL data + duplicates CF_BITMAP/CF_ENHMETAFILE handles, restores all captured formats; pollution window shortened
usage_logs rows reflect actual inject() result: strategy, real ms, success flag, error text; written after injection
usage stats/frecency count only success=1 rows

boundaries: No WM_PASTE fast path, no integrity-level compare, no pipe ACL (documented deferrals)
No UIA injection path restoration — read-only probe only

capability_hooks.must_produce: fail-open gate blocking only confirmed secure fields

acceptance.criterion: grep finds zero alert(/confirm( in src/js + wheel.js
All invoke() calls wrapped by store.call with 5s timeout and user-visible error toast
window.onerror + unhandledrejection installed; keyboard listeners teardown on blur
